tools.name: world-spawn-tool-20261018.json
tools.description: Spawn a new VRChat world: first a public GitHub repo, then a cute one-line link in the Findastra profile README by pull request, then a fresh Unity project skeleton from VCC's World template and the cached VRChat SDK. Never copies another world. Preview by default.
requirements: Python 3 and git. gh for --create-repo and --profile-pr; when gh can't see its sign-in from Python, the tool prints the gh command to run from the shell.
VRChat Creator Companion, with its World template and the SDK zips in its Repos cache, for --apply.
Astra's OK for a new public repo; the profile change is a pull request she merges.
limitations: Steps 4 to 6 (pieces Astra names, the first import, git) are still done by hand.
Unity can't import the SDK under a --dest-root that is too deep while Windows long paths are off; the preview warns.
Offline tests only; no Unity run of a spawned skeleton is recorded.

last_used.evidence: Mommy's World, steps 1 and 2 only, with 0.1.0: the tool derived mommys-world and placed the profile line; gh ran from the shell. findastra/mommys-world (public) and profile PR findastra/findastra#10 (not merged), recorded in findastra/mommys-world PR #1, docs/handoff-claude-20261019-seed.md.
